derivation: _validSpot bounds price/reference in[0.95,1.05]; any shared reference must lie within[price/1.05,price/0.95] for both target and venue. Intersection exists iff max(priceA,priceB)/min(priceA,priceB)<=1.05/0.95. Uses native PoolKey order (ZZZ raw units per native ETH rawunit).
